docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Project layout
docs.text:
mkdocs.yml    # The configuration file.
docs/
    index.md  # The documentation homepage.
    ...       # Other markdown pages, images and other files.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Apache Airflow is a workflow orchestration platform.

flowchart LR
    DAG[DAG Files] --> Scheduler
    Scheduler --> Executor
    Executor --> Worker

    Scheduler <--> DB[(Metadata DB)]
    Worker --> DB
    UI[Airflow UI] <--> DB

docs.title: Scheduler
docs.text: The Scheduler determines which tasks are ready to run.

docs.title: Executor
docs.text: The Executor determines how tasks are executed.
